clauses.clause: Whenever this creature becomes untapped, you may pay {2}. If you do, draw a card.
clauses.evidence: No probe stimulus untaps the card. Tree: TapStateEvent(tapped=False, IS_SOURCE) -> Seq(OptionalEffect(PAY {2}), Conditional(MAY_DONE, DRAW 1 YOU)). Pack untap_pay_draw: after attacking, it untaps on its controller's next turn; paying {2} draws one extra card and empties the pool (pass). Pack untap_decline: no mana spent, no extra card (pass)

clauses.clause: Whenever an opponent casts a spell from anywhere other than their hand, draw a card.
clauses.evidence: The probe casts only your own spells ('you cast an instant or sorcery' / 'a creature' -> none, correct since they are yours). Tree: CastSpellEvent(actor CONTROLLER_IS OPPONENT, from_zone_not HAND OPPONENT) -> DRAW 1 YOU, identical to the compiler's B2b-ghostly-pilferer-cast. Pack opponent_casts_from_hand: an opponent's cast from hand draws nothing (pass)
clauses.issue: The positive case cannot be staged: the pack cast op is hand-only and M21 has no live cast-from-exile or graveyard lane (Chandra, Heart of Fire's permissions are suppressed). In M21 play the trigger therefore never fires, which can only make the card weaker, not stronger

clauses.clause: Discard a card: This creature can't be blocked this turn.
clauses.evidence: Cost CostDiscard(1 card from your hand), the same as the compiler's B5a-discard-cant-be-blocked. [activate [2] from battlefield]: 'ask discard: [you_spare, you_trick, you_land_drop, you_cast_spell, you_cast_creature]'; the chosen card goes hand -> graveyard, hand 5 -> 4. Pack discard_cost_required: refused with an empty hand and the Wall still blocks (pass). Pack discard_unblockable_this_turn: the Wall's block is refused this turn (opp takes 2), and next turn the Wall blocks again (pass)
